name: ob1-auth
comment: The authorization server (SMD-2285). oidc-provider is pinned EXACTLY: its experimental features (CIMD, ack draft-02) take breaking changes in minor releases, and an unacknowledged one stops the server starting. A bump is a PR that runs the proof of concept against this directory's image: `bun evals/eval-auth.ts --up oidc-provider` builds it, `--verify oidc-provider` checks it (CI's auth-poc job does both). It also keeps `bun target.ts --self-check` green: server.ts reads a request's path as the Koa inside oidc-provider does, and that check holds the rule to the installed Koa and parseurl (SMD-2615). The devDependencies are the typecheck's (CI's portable-server job; the image installs --production): @types/oidc-provider moves with oidc-provider, the other three with server-portable's (check 18). `typescript` is also what `target.ts --self-check` walks the server's files with, to hold each function they hand on to a guard or a named reason (SMD-2665).
